audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart claimed Yasuo at Level 1, Skill at Level 2, Yasuo at Level 6 and Quinn at 2+ items — contradicting the already-audited mirror (audits/top/quinn__yasuo) and the 47.94% win rate.
audit.why: Quinn's Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11s at rank 1) blinds Yasuo's autos and Harrier adds bonus damage at every last-hit; Vault (E, 12/11/10/9/8s) leaps her back to max attack range, resetting the gap. Yasuo has no answer until he stacks items and can hold the gap closed.
audit.corrected: Quinn owns rows 0-5, Yasuo owns row 6 — identical to the mirror, stated from Yasuo's side, ratings inverted.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Yasuo swing without noting that Last Breath still needs a knockup Quinn can pre-empt.
audit.why: Last Breath is 70/50/30s and only casts on an Airborne target, so the real tell is two Steel Tempest stacks — and Vault interrupts/repositions before Q2 lands. Yasuo's genuine spike is the crit-item and two-item side-lane window.
audit.corrected: Spike order: Quinn at Vault online and level 6; Yasuo at first crit item, decisive at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wind Wall was described only as 'block her poke' with no cooldown, and the Last Breath requirement was left implicit.
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1, 17s maxed, and lasts only 4 seconds — a wasted wall leaves a 21-second hole where Quinn's Q and ranged autos land freely. Last Breath needs a knockup first, so two Steel Tempest stacks are the tell Quinn watches for.
audit.corrected: Wall her committed Blinding Assault and auto stream in the all-in, not the chip poke; count Q stacks and expect Vault on the second one.

audit.why: Vault at 12s rank 1 down to 8s maxed is the punishable window and the page already keys engages to it.

edits.before: Stack tornado through the wave; your passive shield eats one poke for free. Identify how Quinn contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Blinding Assault (Q) blinds your autos on an 11s cooldown and Harrier chunks you at every last-hit; stack tornado and take the free passive shield.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Quinn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Last Breath (70s at rank 1) needs a knockup first, so two Steel Tempest stacks are the tell; she still kites the level-6 all-in.

edits.before: Last Breath at 6 plus a gank equalize the fight into a skill coin-flip.
edits.after: Last Breath needs a knockup she can Vault away from; she still leads 6.

edits.before: Your first crit item and Wind Wall let you out-trade and wall her Q.
edits.after: One item in, Vault (E) still resets you off her before Q2 lands.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Wind Wall is 4s up and 25s down at rank 1 — spend it on her all-in.

notes: Level chart was rebuilt to match the already-audited mirror (Quinn rows 0-5, Yasuo row 6) and the 47.94% win rate; both layers proposed in pairs. Note the packet levelChart disagrees with the mirror (it had Skill at row 4 and Yasuo at rows 5-6) — I followed the mirror per the no-contradiction rule. Quinn's Q carries no 'projectile' flag in the kit file yet the page says Wind Wall blocks it; consistent with the mirror's judgement that this is a tooltip-parsing miss, so I left that claim standing. Yasuo's W 'terrain: blocks paths and dashes' flag is not supported by Riot's description (projectiles only) — I did not write any Vault-blocking claim.
